newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart Jan-May net cons profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Compart Jan-May net cons profit rises.

text.p: Italian financial holding Compart Spa said its net consolidated profit was 966 billion lire in the first five months of 1997 compared with 819 billion lire in the same 1996 period.

Managing director Enrico Bondi told a shareholders' meeting Compart, formerly Ferruzzi Finanziaria, had a gross operating margin of 1.58 trillion lire for the January-May period, up 14 percent on the same period in 1996.
Turnover grew 13 percent to 11.915 trillion lire. The group figures do not include the company's insurance operations.
